summary.text: Lori Martinez is the Democratic candidate for the New Mexico House of Representatives, District 37, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican Isabella Solis for a seat with no incumbent.
She won the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary with 59.6% of the vote, defeating Matilda Villalobos.
